episode.title: The Autumn Care Package
episode.scene: In the attic living room under warm late-afternoon sunlight, Ichigo stands proudly upright on her hind legs on the polished floorboards, front paws resting on the rim of a hollowed walnut half overflowing with fluffy sage moss, a single dried cranberry, and a giant golden pumpkin seed. Opposite her, Teddy crouches as a massive, shaggy sphere of apricot fur, head tilted down and dark bead eyes studying the lavish miniature hamper resting between his paws.
episode.caption: She spent three days assembling a curated seasonal comfort parcel, half of which she fully intends to reclaim before bedtime.
episode.arcNote: Ichigo assembled an elaborate autumnal comfort basket for Teddy in a polished walnut shell.
episode.motion:
0-1.5s: Ichigo gives the walnut shell one final, decisive shove against Teddy's stubby front paws, whiskers twitching with expectant pride.
1.5-3.5s: Teddy blinks, delicately lifts the oversized pumpkin seed from the bed of moss, and cleanly snaps it in half.
3.5-5s: Ichigo instantly accepts the proffered half with a smug twitch of her nose, tucking it into her cheek as Teddy begins quietly nibbling his.
Camera: Locked off. Sound: Soft scrape of walnut on wood, followed by a crisp seed snap.

trend.name: Boo Basket Gifting Ritual
trend.what: A viral autumn trend on TikTok and Instagram where partners assemble cozy seasonal baskets packed with snacks, blankets, and fall comforts.
trend.hamsterAngle: Ichigo proudly presents Teddy with a polished walnut shell stuffed with a fluffy moss tuft, one roasted pumpkin seed, and an acorn cap.
